subject: Reducing gap between axis label and axis line

messages.author: 87387836bb825314
messages.subject: Reducing gap between axis label and axis line
parts:
Hi,

I've removed the labels and tick marks from the x-axis of one of my
plots, but there is now quite a large gap between the x-axis line and
the x-axis label. Is there any way to reduce this gap?

Regards,

Robin Wilson
University of Southampton

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Reducing gap between axis label and axis line
parts:
Hi,

If you don't want to affect the y axis ticks and margins as well, I
guess you should play with the vjust parameter of the x axis title,

library(ggplot2)

p <- qplot(1,1)
p + scale_x_continuous(breaks=NA) +
opts(axis.title.x = theme_text(size = 12, vjust = 1.5))

HTH,

baptiste
